title: The metaverse is dead but spatial computing is just getting started

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The metaverse died because it relied on clunky VR headsets and empty virtual real estate—no real value, just hype. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Spatial computing isn't just about hardware—it's about AR glasses, real-time 3D mapping, and seamless integration with the physical world. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: True, but spatial computing lacks the unified protocols and open standards the metaverse once promised—fragmented, not scalable. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The metaverse's failure proves we needed a better foundation—spatial computing offers that, with WebXR and real-world interoperability. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future isn’t virtual—it’s spatial. (4 sec)
